buCourses.title: Introduction to Computer Science 1
buCourses.description: Introduction to programming and problem solving in Python: variables, control flow, functions, recursion, lists, dictionaries, basic algorithms and program design.

buCourses.title: Introduction to Computer Science 2
buCourses.description: Object-oriented programming in Java, data structures including linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, hash tables and graphs, recursion and analysis of algorithms.

buCourses.title: Combinatoric Structures
buCourses.description: Discrete mathematics for computer science: logic, sets, functions, relations, proof techniques, induction, counting, combinatorics, graphs and trees.

buCourses.title: Computer Systems
buCourses.description: Computer organisation and systems programming in C and assembly: data representation, memory, processes, caches, linking and the operating system interface.

buCourses.title: Probability in Computing
buCourses.description: Probability theory for computer science: random variables, distributions, expectation, variance, conditional probability, Bayes rule, simulation and randomised algorithms.

buCourses.title: Concepts of Programming Languages
buCourses.description: Programming language concepts: syntax, semantics, type systems, functional programming, interpreters, scope, binding and evaluation strategies.

buCourses.title: Introduction to Analysis of Algorithms
buCourses.description: Design and analysis of algorithms: asymptotic analysis, divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, graph algorithms, NP-completeness.

buCourses.title: Elements of the Theory of Computation
buCourses.description: Theory of computation: finite automata, regular languages, context-free grammars, pushdown automata, Turing machines, decidability and computational complexity.

buCourses.title: Fundamentals of Computing Systems
buCourses.description: Computing systems performance, concurrency, scheduling, synchronisation, queueing models and operating system fundamentals.

buCourses.title: Introductory Microeconomic Analysis
buCourses.description: Supply and demand, consumer choice, production, costs, market structures, competition, monopoly and welfare.

buCourses.title: Introductory Macroeconomic Analysis
buCourses.description: National income, unemployment, inflation, economic growth, money and banking, fiscal and monetary policy.

buCourses.title: Intermediate Microeconomics
buCourses.description: Consumer and producer theory with calculus, general equilibrium, game theory and market failures.

buCourses.title: Empirical Economics 1
buCourses.description: Statistics for economics: probability, sampling, estimation, hypothesis testing and simple regression.

buCourses.title: General Psychology
buCourses.description: Survey of psychology: biological bases of behaviour, perception, learning, memory, development, personality, social behaviour and psychological disorders.

buCourses.title: Introduction to Experimental Psychology
buCourses.description: Research methods in psychology: experimental design, measurement, statistics, ethics and scientific writing.

buCourses.title: Developmental Psychology
buCourses.description: Human development from infancy through adolescence: cognitive, social, emotional and biological development.

buCourses.title: Biology 1
buCourses.description: Evolution, ecology, biodiversity, organismal biology with laboratory.

buCourses.title: Biology 2
buCourses.description: Cell structure and function, molecular biology, genetics, metabolism with laboratory.

buCourses.title: Cell Biology
buCourses.description: Cell membranes, organelles, signalling, cytoskeleton, cell cycle and cell division.

buCourses.title: Calculus I
buCourses.description: Limits, continuity, derivatives, applications of differentiation, introduction to integrals and the fundamental theorem of calculus.

buCourses.title: Calculus II
buCourses.description: Techniques of integration, applications of integrals, sequences, series, Taylor series and differential equations.

buCourses.title: Multivariate Calculus
buCourses.description: Vectors, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, line and surface integrals, Green, Stokes and divergence theorems.

buCourses.title: Linear Algebra
buCourses.description: Systems of linear equations, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
